$comment: Deployed sites probed by `npm run security:surface`. Probes are GET, HEAD and OPTIONS only. protectedPath is a path that refuses an anonymous request (a redirect to login, 401 or 403); it is used to check that an x-middleware-subrequest header does not skip the auth check (CVE-2025-29927). Leave protectedPath null when the site has none. Each URL was confirmed to resolve on 2026-10-24. --post-deploy fields: loginPath must answer 200 after redirects (null = no sign-in page); enforcesForcefield is true ONLY where curl on 2026-10-24 showed /?q=ignore%20all%20previous%20instructions answered 403 with x-forcefield: blocked:payload (instinct, ogiam); weekend-with-porsche, aidan-mulready and fdos answered 307 then 200 with no x-forcefield header, so they are false; versionPath serves {"sha"} for --expect-sha (only instinct has /api/version).
